$comment: Single source of truth for how every distribution channel describes kya, and for the screenshots they show. Edit here, then run `pnpm sync:channel-copy`; `pnpm check:channel-copy` (CI) fails on any drift. Every variant starts with the tagline. Keep it truthful: local OSS is advisory and fails open except the never-list and the guard pack; never claim OSS enforcement or call the hosted console GA.
short: Stops your coding agent from deleting, leaking or dropping things.

guardListing.$comment: Listing text of the kya-guard plugin for directory forms: at most 50, 150 and 500 characters. plugins/kya-guard/submission/description-<n>.txt must equal these (check-channel-copy.mjs). chars150 and chars500 start with the tagline and contain variants.guard.
guardListing.chars50: Stops coding agents deleting, leaking or dropping.
guardListing.chars150: Stops your coding agent from deleting, leaking or dropping things. No network, one file, fails open. For Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini.
guardListing.chars500: Stops your coding agent from deleting, leaking or dropping things. No network, one file, fails open. KYA Guard checks every tool call before it runs. It stops destructive commands (terraform destroy, DROP TABLE, git push --force, rm -rf ~), reads of credential files, secrets written into files and secrets sent over the network. A few risky commands ask you first. The check is local and offline. If the guard fails, the call goes ahead and one error line is written. Needs Node.js 22 or later.

Changes tab - what actually changed per session: files touched with redacted diff previews

Gateway policies - local gate policy rules
Gateway routes - which tools route to which backend
Gateway section - local MCP gate with listeners, routes, backends, policies, and a dry-run playground
KYA report - live dashboard: the Blocked panel first, then verdicts and analytics
